title: Supplementing LRT Train Journeys During Peak Times with Increased Frequency in Bus Services
what_it_is: Supplementing LRT Train Journeys During Peak Times with Increased Frequency in Bus Services

sections.label: Punggol LRT and bus capacity
sections.summary: Punggol LRT is supplemented by 18 bus services, and LTA is adding bus frequency, double-deck buses and two-car LRT trains.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport for growing towns like Punggol where the demand on the LRT system can be very busy during peak times and drop drastically during non-peak times, whether the Ministry will consider supplementing the LRT system with more frequent bus services in the interim, if it is not yet feasible to bring in additional LRT train sets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: It is supplemented by 18 bus services that serve all the LRT stations and provide connectivity to the town centre and beyond.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are increasing public transport capacity in Punggol, in anticipation of new residents moving into the town.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) recently added frequency to some bus services and is using more double-deck buses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA is closely monitoring the situation and will add more bus trips during peak hours if necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: From next year, LTA will progressively replace the existing one-car LRT trains on both Punggol and Sengkang LRT systems with new two-car LRT trains, to increase the overall capacity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The North East Line will also be extended to Punggol Coast next year, with the opening of a new Punggol Coast MRT station.

sections.label: Two-car LRT trains replacement
sections.summary: From next year, one-car trains on both Punggol and Sengkang LRT will be replaced with two-car trains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Starting from next year, we will be replacing the one-car trains with two-car trains on both Punggol and Sengkang LRT.
